rca of the issue: Offer banner-color red on the FUEL POS: the field `banner_color` is persisted per Offer in MongoDB with default '#E23744' (set when offers were created in earlier iterations). CashierPOS.tsx line 347 reads this raw value as the inline background. Skin-only Phase 2 changed CSS tokens but cannot affect previously-persisted document fields. Mitigation: either patch existing offers in DB (e.g., UPDATE offers SET banner_color='#15140F' WHERE banner_color='#E23744') and change the OfferCreate default, OR have the POS map any non-FUEL hex back to a FUEL token before rendering.
